reason: I already keep a spreadsheet for my freelance income and card bills, and it works. Setting up an iPhone Shortcut and handing my bank slips to an app to save me a few minutes a week does not feel like enough of a gain yet, even at 69 baht.
objection: I would be sending my bank slips and card statement details to a new app I have never used. Saying the data is encrypted does not tell me who can read it or what happens if the company closes.
would_change_my_mind: If I could try the card statement import on my own statement for free, see my categories filled in correctly, and confirm the data stays on my side or is clearly explained.
